text: Pressed E repeatedly (tap and 0.3s hold) with the crosshair on the dark lantern in the lit window left of Nana's door, from ~3 distances; Lanterns stays 0 of 4, no prompt or message appears. No in-range/target cue tells me whether I'm close enough or aimed right.

Knocking at the Garcias' (E at the door) works: Mr. Garcia gives 2 candy and a notebook page. So E itself works; it only failed at Nana's window lantern. NEXT still insists on the lantern, so the HUD gives no trick-or-treat guidance once stuck.

At the Okafors' door, standing against the lit door, the whole screen is flat orange and the orange dialogue text (joke prompt, Mrs. Okafor's reply) is hard to read; HUD white text also low-contrast. Joke flow itself works: T gives 3 candy (2->5).

Mrs. Okafor asks me to light the lantern at the end of her porch. Walked to it (small dark lantern by the pumpkin, left porch end), crosshair on it, E: nothing, Lanterns 0 of 4. Second lantern that will not light; NEXT also never updates to mention her request. Also 'You have been here tonight' stays on screen the whole time I'm on her porch.

Okafors' lantern finally lit (Lanterns 1 of 4) only after walking until the lantern was almost under my feet and looking down. The E range for lanterns is far shorter than for doors, and nothing on screen (no 'E: light' prompt, no highlight) says when you are in range; I had pressed E ~1.5 m away with the crosshair on it several times.

Each knock took 2-4 tries of turning/stepping on the porch (Okafors', Ms. Bright's, Novaks'): E at a door does nothing unless you are almost touching it and facing it squarely, with no prompt to say when you are in range. The Novaks' door also renders black/unlit even though they answer. Mr. Novak says 'Two each' to a lone trick-or-treater.

After trick-or-treating (Garcias', Okafors', Ms. Bright's, Novaks') I tried to return to Nana's for the window lantern NEXT keeps pointing at, and got lost: house names only appear when close, there is no map, compass or arrow to Nana's, and the NEXT text gives no direction. Ended up at Abbas's Market at 9:16 pm. A 'which way home' cue (arrow, Nana's porch light, map page in the notebook) is missing.

Nana's window lantern finally lit at 10:03 pm game time (Lanterns 2 of 4) after coming at it from the side of the porch. Root cause of my first 20 game-minutes stuck: Nana stands directly in front of that window, so from the walk you cannot get close enough (E range is tiny) and nothing says 'move closer'. The objective that is supposed to be 'always first' was the hardest thing in the opening. NEXT now lists cider ingredients (apples, rosemary, cinnamon) - clear.

Looking for 'Nana's herb bed' (NEXT, both as Wren and as cat) around the side/back of Nana's house at 10:15-10:21 pm: the yard is almost black away from the porch, no label appears, and as a cat I saw no glowing paw prints. A dark low box (maybe the bed?) is barely visible. Couldn't find the herb bed before my time budget ran out.
